target.title: improve(ci): reduce Blacksmith registrations for pull requests
target.body:
Closes #106131

## What Problem This Solves

Full source-change pull requests currently start 48-50 Blacksmith jobs, all inside the first five minutes. Bursty CI traffic therefore spends avoidable runner registrations and reduces shared headroom even when Blacksmith compute capacity is available.

## Why This Change Was Made

Move the independent `security-fast` job to GitHub-hosted Ubuntu and rebalance only the pull-request compact Node plan from 19 runnable jobs to 14. Keep `preflight` on the shortest critical path, keep `pnpm-store-warmup` on Blacksmith's colocated cache backend, and leave main, release, coverage, runner classes, subprocess isolation, and dist boundaries unchanged.

## User Impact

No product behavior changes. A full pull request should use roughly six fewer Blacksmith registrations (about 12%) while retaining the same test coverage and keeping wall time within the recent 356-554 second range.

## Evidence

- Baseline: five recent successful full PR runs started 48, 48, 49, 50, and 49 Blacksmith jobs; every registration occurred in the first five minutes.
- Generated plan: 20 total / 19 runnable compact Node jobs becomes 15 total / 14 runnable jobs; test coverage, per-group subprocesses, dist separation, timeouts, and main/release topology remain asserted.
- Testbox `tbx_01kxd48sz9wjfka0466r52q6qf`: 73 focused tests passed; workflow validation and `oxfmt --check` passed.
- `git diff --check`: passed.
- Fresh autoreview: clean after retaining `pnpm-store-warmup` on Blacksmith's cache backend.
- Exact head `464189fc1839`: [CI run 29232122286](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29232122286) started 45 non-skipped Blacksmith jobs, all inside five minutes, plus two hosted jobs. The measured count is three below the 48-job source-only baseline even though this CI/docs change additionally activates `check-docs`, `checks-windows-node-test`, and `native-i18n`; normalized for those lanes, the topology removes six Blacksmith registrations.
- Exact-head wall time: 465 seconds versus 355-553 seconds across the five baseline runs. The slowest consolidated shard took 413 seconds versus 323-501 seconds for the slowest baseline compact shards.
- Exact-head failures are current-`main` drift from #105674, outside this five-file diff: `check-lint` and `check-dependencies` report `src/skills/workshop/experience-review.ts`; the compact tooling group reports its missing live-test inventory entry. Main run [29232021168](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29232021168) independently reproduces the dependency failure.
